Someone asks how could a toilet paper roll could become too high and difficult lift or remove.
When you run through lots on the last piece to finish in roll a thin paper is usually stuck under and over folds at end, and the last few inches may become bobbled up.
It gets too tight in holder and the last roll looks bigger. If not fixed properly can lead roll be to get caught in cardboard cut and roll hard too much and difficult move out of case without bending box and holder or pulling off all.
You have two methods.
- Try twisting roll back into roll. Start by turning it a  quarter at first, as the last roll can often have a bend on top, if top has curve it usually bend out to top, not to end and easier get in to twist roll, but need some effort if end bended to bottom it's a more tricky twist
